Selection: Six lowest SHA256(phase8-eval-v1/OracleId) per keyword stratum; exclude phase7 reference names; not representative and no independent reviewer.
Labeling: Same developer, after parser freeze, before viewing per-card predictions; no independent reviewer. Role meaning is bounded as documented, not full semantic equivalence.

Cases.Name: Sound the Trumpets
Cases.OracleText: Counter target spell. If that spell's mana value was 2 or less, recruit. (Draw a card, then discard a card. If you discarded a nonland card, create a 1/1 white Human Soldier creature token.)
Cases.ReviewNote: Counter met voorwaardelijk extra recruit-effect; voorwaarden behouden.

Cases.Name: Spellgyre
Cases.OracleText:
Choose one —
• Counter target spell.
• Surveil 2, then draw two cards. (To surveil 2, look at the top two cards of your library, then put any number of them into your graveyard and the rest on top of your library in any order.)
Cases.ReviewNote: Modale keuze; geen onvoorwaardelijke combinatie van counter en draw.

Cases.Name: Three Steps Ahead
Cases.OracleText:
Spree (Choose one or more additional costs.)
+ {1}{U} — Counter target spell.
+ {3} — Create a token that's a copy of target artifact or creature you control.
+ {2} — Draw two cards, then discard a card.
Cases.ReviewNote: Modale extra kosten per gekozen effect.

Cases.Name: Spectral Interference
Cases.OracleText: Counter target artifact or creature spell unless its controller pays {4}.
Cases.ReviewNote: Beperkte doelgroepen en betaaluitweg.

Cases.OracleText:
Choose one —

• Draw two cards, then discard a card.
Cases.ReviewNote: Modaal, betaaluitweg of draw/discard.

Cases.Name: Emerge from the Cocoon
Cases.OracleText: Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. You gain 3 life.
Cases.ReviewNote: Reanimatie vanuit eigen graveyard; geen gerichte removal.

Choose one —

Cases.Name: Pensive Professor

Increment (Whenever you cast a spell, if the amount of mana you spent is greater than this creature's power or toughness, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.)
Whenever one or more +1/+1 counters are put on this creature, draw a card.

Deathtouch, lifelink
Whenever Locke Cole deals combat damage to a player, draw a card, then discard a card.
